definitions: a person (of either sex) entering the first year of an institution, especially a high school (ninth grade for US, grade 9 for  Canada, grade 7 for Philippines), a university, or legislative body
a novice; one in the rudiments of knowledge

blocks.text: A freshman, fresher, first year, or colloquially frosh, is a person in the first year at an educational institution, usually a secondary school or at the college and university level, but also in other forms of post-secondary educational institutions or primary school.
